title.zh: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks
title.en: Zcash targets November for NU7 mainnet upgrade with 25-second blocks

current_state.zh: Zcash developers have reached unanimous agreement to target November 5 for the NU7 mainnet upgrade, which will cut block times to 25 seconds, disable version 4 transactions, and integrate the Network Sustainability Mechanism while preserving the halving schedule.
current_state.en: Zcash developers have reached unanimous agreement to target November 5 for the NU7 mainnet upgrade, which will cut block times to 25 seconds, disable version 4 transactions, and integrate the Network Sustainability Mechanism while preserving the halving schedule.
